mLocKeys.keySummary: Lux's damaging spells charge the target with energy for 6 seconds. Lux's next attack ignites the energy, dealing bonus magic damage (depending on Lux's level) to the target.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: <mainText>Damaging spells afflict enemies with <keyword>Illumination</keyword> for 6 seconds. Lux's basic attacks consume <keyword>Illumination</keyword>, dealing <magicDamage>@TotalDamage@ magic damage</magicDamage>. </mainText>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Lux releases a sphere of light that binds and deals damage to up to two enemy units.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Fires a ball of light, <status>Rooting</status> the first enemy hit for 2 seconds and dealing <magicDamage>@TotalDamageTT@ magic damage</magicDamage>. The second enemy is dealt <magicDamage>@HalfTotalDamageTT@</magicDamage> and <status>Rooted</status> for 1 second.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Fires an anomaly of twisted light to an area, which slows nearby enemies. Lux can detonate it to damage enemies in the area of effect.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Create a zone that Slows enemies by @SlowPercent@%. After 5 seconds the zone detonates dealing @TotalDamageTT@ magic damage.

Recast to detonate early.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Lux throws her wand and bends the light around any friendly target it touches, protecting them from enemy damage.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Throws Lux's wand to a target location and back, <shield>shielding</shield> herself and all allied Champions it touches from <shield>@TotalShieldTT@ damage</shield> for 3 seconds.

mLocKeys.keySummary: After gathering energy, Lux fires a beam of light that deals damage to all targets in the area.  In addition, triggers Lux's passive ability and refreshes the Illumination debuff duration.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Channels a dazzling ray of light dealing <magicDamage>@TotalDamage@ magic damage</magicDamage> to all enemies in a line. <spellName>Finales Funkeln</spellName> ignites and refreshes <spellName>Illumination</spellName>.
